findings.title: Infants hardest hit as meningitis cases continue to rise in Gaza
findings.location: Gaza Strip, especially Gaza City and Khan Yunis; WHO briefing in Geneva
findings.affected_population_system: WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier reported more than 533 meningitis cases and four deaths since mid-October; infants under one account for 71% of cases reported since October, newborns 13%, and 73% of patients are displaced. Limited laboratory capacity impedes viral/bacterial differentiation. Counts cover different reporting periods from earlier ministry figures and must not be added.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Children under the age of one account for 71% of cases reported since October, with newborns alone accounting for 13% of all cases, he said.
findings.source_type: Established news agency reporting named WHO spokesperson at Geneva briefing
